item.title: CyberLeek's dark side: its cryptocurrency surges while the movement it cited disowns it
item.description: The CYBERLEEK token surged over 14x in 24 hours while Stop Killing Games, the movement the leaker cited as inspiration, publicly distanced itself from their actions.
